A non-contiguous src therefore produced silently wrong results. description: model-saver : fix expert shared/chunk FFN length key clobber ( #26693 ) The saver called add_kv with LLM_KV_EXPERT_SHARED_FEED_FORWARD_LENGTH twice, the second time passing n_ff_chexp. gguf_set_val_u32 removes-then-appends, so the second call clobbers the first: the saved shared_feed_forward_length ends up as n_ff_chexp (0 for every arch except GroveMoE), and expert_chunk_feed_forward_length is never written at all.
